patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution editorial photography dominates sections, often with text overlays, creating an immersive, magazine-like experience.
A sophisticated serif typeface is used for the brand logo and key headings, contrasted with a clean, minimalist sans-serif for body text and navigation elements.
A stark black and white palette forms the base, allowing the rich, desaturated tones of the photography to provide visual interest and depth.
The primary navigation and a top promotional banner transform from transparent overlays to solid black, sticky headers upon scroll, maintaining brand presence and improving legibility.
Large, impactful hero and feature image sections are interspersed with smaller, grid-based product or service showcases, creating a dynamic visual rhythm.

technique_notes: Full-bleed, high-resolution photography is used as background elements for entire sections, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility and create a dramatic mood.

The main navigation and a top promotional bar are initially transparent and overlay the hero content. Upon scrolling, they transition to a solid black background and become sticky at the top of the viewport, using a smooth CSS animation for the background change.
Content sections are presented as large, immersive image blocks, sometimes with text and call-to-action buttons directly overlaid, creating a magazine-like editorial feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (~3-4x body) for impact, complemented by smaller, refined sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with significant vertical padding between major content blocks and full-bleed images, creating a sense of luxury and space.

standout: The site's standout feature is its unwavering commitment to high-fashion editorial photography, which serves as the primary design element rather than just supporting content. This creates an immersive, magazine-like experience that prioritizes visual storytelling and brand mood over typical product catalog layouts.
